617:t_000:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Quite the spectacle. As expected of the elite who guard the imperial capital $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

617:t_000:1.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「If it weren't for $$アウストラリス$$'s orders, I'd have sortied with them.」

617:t_000:2.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Looks like you've shaken it off.」

617:t_000:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「What are you talking about?」

617:t_000:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Aha, it really is embarrassing! Having someone overhear your love confession!」

617:t_000:6.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「What about you, $$尸空#pilot$$? Are you okay with... what happened to $$尸刻$$-chan?」

617:t_000:7.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「For $$鬼宿$$, death is nothing more than a result.」

617:t_000:10.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You lot are disgusting. Acting as if this were the final battle.」

617:t_000:11.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You do understand, don't you? That our battle, which was promised eternity, will go on and on?」

617:t_000:12.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「You don't need to tell me, $$バルビエル$$. ...But I'm sure the fighting on Earth ends with this.」

617:t_000:13.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Once we've beaten $c, all that's left is mopping up the small fry, so we'll probably be going back to the galaxy too.」

617:t_000:14.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「With four new $$スフィア$$s as a souvenir.」

617:t_000:15.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「That's right. That is exactly the duty of us, the $$サイデリアル$$'s $$スフィア・リアクター$$s.」

617:t_000:16.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「But don't let your guard down. $c is completely different from when they came here before.」

617:t_000:17.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I know them better than you two do...」

617:t_000:18.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「The same civilization of fire... the same Earthlings...」

617:t_000:19.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Shut up, $$尸空#pilot$$. I'm a chosen human, granted the name $$バルビエル$$.」

617:t_000:21.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「The games are over. I'm dying to kill them, absolutely dying to...」

617:t_000:22.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Even $$アウストラリス$$ gave me permission...! Even if it means letting the $$スフィア$$s get away, I'll be the one to kill them!」

617:t_000:23.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「If our appeal doesn't get through to them, go right ahead and do that.」

617:t_001:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Reactors! Sitting back to size us up, with all that composure!」

617:t_001:1.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$皇帝アウストラリス$$ isn't here either, huh.」

617:t_001:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「So high and mighty! Acting like a big shot!」

617:t_001:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(Judging by how the Empire's Reactors behave, $$アウストラリス$$ is indeed the leader type, but no clear chain of command can be seen among them.)

617:t_001:4.en:
$$シャア$$
(The fact that he doesn't come to the front lines should be taken as a sign of some intent.)

617:t_001:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Welcome to $$ラース・バビロン$$! A toast to your courage, coming back again before the memory of losing and fleeing home has even cooled!」

617:t_001:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「A cheap provocation. You're disgracing the name of Supreme Commander of the Empire's army.」

617:t_001:8.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「But you see, with one colleague who opens their mouth only to curse and another who barely speaks at all, I'm the one who ends up having to handle the MC job.」

617:t_001:9.en:
$$アルト$$
「We didn't come here to waste time chatting!」

617:t_001:10.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Don't get so worked up. We're seething inside too, you know, now that our lovable $$ダバラーン$$ has been taken down.」

617:t_001:11.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I'd like you to understand my position too, holding all that back and doing the talking.」

617:t_001:12.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「If it is talks you want, I will oblige.」

617:t_001:13.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「But first, you will answer this: why has the $$サイデリアル$$ loathed the evolution of humanity and kept watch over Earth?」

617:t_001:14.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「...I can't tell you that.」

617:t_001:15.en:
$$シモン$$
「In other words, you've got no intention of really talking with us!」

617:t_001:16.en:
$$桂$$
「Negotiations have broken down... that's fine to say, right, $$ロジャー$$?」

617:t_001:18.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Hold on a second! You're so hasty...」

617:t_001:19.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I don't even want to fight you lot.」

617:t_001:21.en:
$$甲児$$
「You're saying you got cold feet now that it's come to this!」

617:t_001:22.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Hmm... that word isn't quite right, but it's true that we acknowledge your strength.」

617:t_001:23.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「So, how about this... How about the whole planet joins the $$サイデリアル$$?」

617:t_001:25.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「As you know, the $$サイデリアル$$ is a military alliance of people from different star systems.」

617:t_001:26.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Even I was originally a drifter who got invited and became one of them.」

617:t_001:27.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Not just the four Reactors - you mean to win us over as well?」

617:t_001:28.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「With your abilities, you'd be unit commanders right away, and some of you could make division commander... no, even general, I think.」

617:t_001:29.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「If that happened, I think this planet's people too would be guaranteed a decent standing as collaborators, instead of being treated like pets.」

617:t_001:30.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「By a decent standing, you mean freedom granted under your surveillance?」

617:t_001:31.en:
$$レド$$
「That's not how a human lives.」

617:t_001:32.en:
$$バナージ$$
「And those with a strong life force get used as parts of your $$次元力$$ control system...!」

617:t_001:33.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Even so, the vast majority of people can live peaceful lives.」

617:t_001:34.en:
$$アマタ$$
「That's not peace or anything of the kind!」

617:t_001:35.en:
$$シン$$
「We've learned the truth! We won't let you do as you please with this planet any longer!」

617:t_001:36.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The world you manage ends today!」

617:t_001:39.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Even after learning of the existence of their superiors, the people of this planet don't cower - their fighting spirit only burns hotter.」

617:t_001:40.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Reckless courage born of ignorance. Their stupidity is truly extreme.」

617:t_001:41.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「There's no need to show mercy to people like that...!」

617:t_001:42.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Shut up! I won't be called an idiot by someone who comes to other people's planet and does whatever they want!」

617:t_001:43.en:
$$正太郎$$
「If you say you acknowledge us... Earthlings, then give this planet back!」

617:t_001:44.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「...No room for negotiation, then.」

617:t_001:45.en:
$$赤木$$
「You call this one-sided talk a negotiation!?」

617:t_001:46.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「So this battle really can't be avoided...!」

617:t_001:48.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「This is our will! Brace yourselves, $$新地球皇国$$!」

617:t_001:49.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「...That will please $$アウストラリス$$.」

617:t_001:50.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「First, let's watch. How they fight against the elite guarding this imperial capital.」

617:t_001:51.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Don't underestimate us, scorpion bastard! It's a big mistake to think you can take us down easily!」

617:t_001:52.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We carry the feelings of people all over the world, and that's why we're here!」

617:t_001:53.en:
$$ノノ$$
「The feelings of Earth's people, who don't flinch even in front of a giant enemy, are pushing this $c on from behind right now!」

617:t_001:54.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「The feelings of Earth's people, who don't flinch even in front of a giant enemy, are pushing this $c on from behind right now!」
